annotations.title: Turn a design into a Nityaflow workflow link

description: Checks a Nityaflow workflow design and keeps it for 14 days behind a link. Opening the link shows the workflow in the Nityaflow editor with every step filled in and a safe test run; nothing runs or sends until the person reviews it and switches it on. Returns the link and the list of accounts the person still has to connect. Designs that contain passwords, API keys or tokens are refused.

workflow.description: A workflow design in the JSON shape from the design guide: {name, summary, nodes: [{ref, type, name, params}], edges: [{from, out, to}], limits, todo}.

name: create_workflow_draft
